title: How do three round marks join into one final expression?
description: The marks of three quiz rounds are added as three brackets, the brackets are removed, and the like terms are grouped. The final expression is checked with p as four and q as one. Keeko's doubt is that the final marks are twenty one p plus nine q.
teaching_notes: One idea: brackets joined by plus signs open without any change of sign, and then the p terms and the q terms are grouped. Watch for students who lose the minus signs in front of the q terms.

source: Find Leeza's final score as an expression by adding her thre
video_script.why: A learner sees how three expressions in brackets join into one final expression.
video_script.substitution: the book's three quiz rounds with marks seven p minus three q, eight p minus four q and six p minus two q, checked with p as four and q as one
video_script.anchor: the three quiz rounds of the book, added as three brackets
video_script.wrong_answer: twenty one p plus nine q
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko adds the numbers in front of the q terms and drops their minus signs. Each q term was taken away, so the idea is broken with p as four and q as one.
video_script.payoff_line: The final marks are twenty one p minus nine q. That is seventy five when p is four and q is one

final_answer.value: 21p − 9q, which is 75 when p = 4 and q = 1
final_answer.spoken: twenty one p minus nine q, which is seventy five when p is four and q is one

names.Leeza: plays a quiz in three rounds and gets marks like seven p minus three q

maths_rules: Keeko test with p = 4, q = 1: 21 x 4 + 9 x 1 = 93, which is not 75
video_script.design: The three rounds stay on the board; they are added as brackets, the brackets are removed, like terms are grouped, and the result is checked with the three round marks.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; the three quiz rounds of Leeza: 7p − 3q, 8p − 4q, 6p − 2q

marks.scene: the title card arrives and the quiz board is drawn
marks.rounds: the three round expressions are written in a column
marks.ask: a question mark appears beside the column

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is the next part of the quiz question in your book.
<bookmark mark='rounds'/>Leeza has three round marks. They are seven p minus three q, eight p minus four q, and six p minus two q.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>The book wants the final marks as one expression. What will it look like?

beats.on_screen: the three rounds stay on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits beside the quiz board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

marks.open: the bracket is removed and 10 + 3 − 1 = 12 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='bracket'/>Ten plus the bracket three minus one is ten plus two, which is twelve.
<bookmark mark='open'/>Take the bracket away, and ten plus three minus one is also twelve.
<bookmark mark='same'/>A plus sign before a bracket leaves the signs inside as they are.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the marks of the three rounds of Leeza.

beats.on_screen: To find: the final marks as one expression, checked with p = 4, q = 1

marks.find: the words final marks as one expression are written
marks.then: the words check with p = 4 and q = 1 are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the final marks as one expression.
<bookmark mark='then'/>Then we check it with p as four and q as one.

marks.sum: the three rounds are joined by plus signs

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>Step one, the final marks are the sum of the three rounds.
<bookmark mark='line'/>Write each round in a bracket and join them with plus signs.

marks.open: the three brackets are removed and no sign changes

narration: <bookmark mark='open'/>Step two, remove the brackets, because the sign before each bracket is plus.
<bookmark mark='line'/>The signs inside stay as they are.

marks.group: the p terms are grouped in one colour and the q terms in another

narration: <bookmark mark='group'/>Step three, group the p terms together and the q terms together.
<bookmark mark='bracket'/>The p terms add to seven plus eight plus six. The q terms add to three plus four plus two.
<bookmark mark='short'/>That is twenty one p minus nine q.
<bookmark mark='short'/>Step four, put p as four and q as one.
<bookmark mark='rounds'/>Eighty four minus nine is seventy five. The rounds were twenty five, twenty eight and twenty two, which also add to seventy five.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 21p − 9q, which is 75 when p = 4 and q = 1
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The final marks are twenty one p minus nine q. That is seventy five when p is four and q is one.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the quiz board
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble: 21p + 9q, struck out; the test p = 4, q = 1 gives 75 and 93

marks.gap: 75 and 93 appear side by side and do not match
marks.fix: the bubble is struck out and 21p − 9q stays

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the final marks are twenty one p plus nine q. Keeko dropped the minus signs.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Try p as four and q as one.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>The rounds add to seventy five, but that idea gives ninety three.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Every q term was taken away, so the nine q is taken away too.
